messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: High error rate on rollout policy 'policy-v3' canary. 500s and increased tail latency observed; automatic fallback active. impact: ~5% of requests -> eu-region-variant-b. link: https://redwood.in/alerts/1918007654 :rotating_light:

maria-g: ack. paging @ryan-oncall. tagging eng-runtime and sre. any quick read on customer impact?

aj: looking at the ingress logs now. seeing a spike in grpc errors from routing service at 03:42 UTC. sample: `2026-03-15T03:42:10Z ERROR routepicker: failed to select target: variant-mismatch`

ryan-oncall: i'm oncall and seeing the page. give me a minute to pull traces. what did the canary weight look like?

eli-sre: canary weight was 8% with fallback policy: `sticky: true, fallback_variant: eu-variant-b, max_fallback_duration: 30m`. suspecting sticky fallback + region routing caused a sticky route to a variant that fails under load.

kim-runtime: confirming — the rollout config for policy-v3 shows sticky fallback enabled to preserve session affinity. here's the snippet from the rollout manifest:

```yaml
rollout:
  name: policy-v3
  canary: 8%
  fallback:
    type: variant
    variant: "eu-variant-b"
    sticky: true
    sticky_ttl: 1800s
```

maria-g: customer impact check? which customers hit the failing path?

aj: cross-referencing traces with billing ids. two customers show elevated 500s and degraded SLA: AcmeApps (eu-billing) and FathomAnalytics. both are heavy in EU-REGION. approximate failed requests: 1.2k in last 5m.

ryan-oncall: thanks. i'm going to pause the canary rollout and disable sticky fallback to stop stateful stickiness into the bad variant. can someone confirm rollback / pause command?

deploy-bot: Received command: `rollback policy-v3 --type=canary --confirm`. Executing staged pause...

kim-runtime: before rollback, quick mitigation: set fallback.sticky=false for policy-v3 via feature toggle. command: `rwctl policy update policy-v3 --fallback.sticky=false`

eli-sre: that sounds safer — non-sticky fallback will allow routing to pick a healthy variant instead of forcing traf to the failing EU variant. we still need to pause the canary to stop more users being routed to it.

ryan-oncall: running both: pausing canary + flip fallback. i'll run the rwctl commands now.

ryan-oncall: `rwctl rollout pause policy-v3` -> accepted.

ryan-oncall: `rwctl policy update policy-v3 --fallback.sticky=false` -> accepted.

incident-bot: Action log: rollout paused by ryan-oncall at 03:45 UTC. policy updated: fallback.sticky=false by ryan-oncall.

maria-g: monitoring metrics — can someone post the error rate and p95?

aj: graphs: error rate dropped from 6.8% to 1.1% over 4m after changes. p95 latency for EU requests decreased from 720ms to 210ms.

samantha-pm: notifying affected accounts (AcmeApps, FathomAnalytics) via standard incident template. they were seeing failed completions; ops outreach in progress.

kim-runtime: still want to investigate root cause: why did eu-variant-b fail under canary weight? looks like eu-variant-b has a model binary mismatch against the serving runtime here (kv-cache schema mismatch). logs: `kv_cache: incompatible-kv-schema v2 vs v1` on startup of variant. perhaps model package wasn't validated for that runtime build.

eli-sre: good catch. that explains 500s on requests that hit the variant. also explains why sticky made it worse — sticky kept users bound to that bad variant.

maria-g: next steps: 1) rollback canary (we paused), 2) disable sticky fallback (done), 3) upgrade eu-variant-b packaging with runtime-compatible model binary, 4) add pre-serve validation to prevent variant with kv-schema mismatch from receiving traffic. assign owners?

kim-runtime: i'll own the packaging fix and pre-serve validator. target hotfix in next 2 hours, will post progress.

aj: i'll run a sweep to find other rollout manifests that have sticky fallback enabled and flag them for review (script: `scripts/find_sticky_fallbacks.sh | xargs -n1 echo`).

ryan-oncall: leaving final checks to oncall follow-up. i'll hand to eli-sre for post-incident and to kim for runtime fix.

eli-sre: i'll open an incident ticket and schedule the blameless postmortem. initial impact: two paying customers saw errors for ~12 minutes; internal metric alert threshold tripped. severity: Sev2.

maria-g: thanks everyone. please add timeline and links to logs in the incident ticket.

deploy-bot: Completed: rollback paused, feature toggle applied. no further automated rollouts will run for policy-v3 until manual resume.

kim-runtime: quick note — recommend changing default fallback.sticky to false in rollout templates unless affinity is explicitly required. will put up a PR.

eli-sre: agreed. adding alerting rule: if fallback.sticky=true and variant has serving errors > 1% for 5m -> auto-disable sticky and notify oncall. will draft alert.

samantha-pm: customer comms draft shared in #customer-success for review.

maria-g: closing loop: error rate stable, customers contacted, owners assigned. will keep thread open until runtime fix deployed. :white_check_mark:
